units.zh: 李德裕因奏：「陳行泰、張絳皆令大將上奏，邀求節旄，所以必不可與。
units.en: Li Deyu then memorialized, "Both Chen Xingtai and Zhang Jiang had their generals petition the throne demanding commissions — for that reason they must on no account be granted.
units.literal: Li Deyu thereupon memorialized: "Chen Xingtai and Zhang Jiang both had great generals submit memorials to demand seals and credentials — therefore they must on no account be granted.

units.zh: 仲武由是威加北狄，表請於薊北立《紀聖功銘》，敕李德裕為之文，其銘曰：太和之初，赤氣宵興；
units.en: Zhongwu's prestige over the northern peoples was now supreme. He memorialized asking that a Record of Sacred Merit stele be erected north of Ji, and the court ordered Li Deyu to compose the inscription, which reads: In early Taihe crimson vapors rose at night;
units.literal: Zhongwu thereby gained authority over the northern barbarians; he memorialized requesting that a "Record of Sacred Merit" stele be erected north of Ji, and an edict ordered Li Deyu to compose the text. The inscription reads: At the beginning of Taihe, crimson vapors rose through the night;

units.zh: 今仲武上表布誠，先陳密款，因而拔用，即似有名。」
units.en: Zhongwu has now memorialized the throne with a pledge of loyalty, offering his allegiance in advance. To appoint him on that basis would seem legitimate."
units.literal: Now Zhongwu has submitted a memorial declaring his loyalty, first setting forth a secret pledge of allegiance; to promote him on that basis would seem justified."

units.zh: 開成之末，彤雲暮凝。
units.en: By the close of Kaicheng rosy clouds hung thick at dusk.
units.literal: At the end of Kaicheng, rosy clouds congealed at dusk.

units.zh: 異鳥南來，胡滅之征。
units.en: Strange birds flew from the south, portending the barbarians' destruction.
units.literal: Strange birds came from the south — a sign that the barbarians would be destroyed.

units.zh: 北夷飈掃，厥國土崩。
units.en: Northern tribes were swept away in a whirlwind, and their realm collapsed.
units.literal: Northern tribes were swept away like a storm; their state collapsed.

units.zh: 逼迫遷徙，震我邊鄙；
units.en: Driven into migration, they shook our frontier lands;
units.literal: Driven and forced to migrate, they shook our frontier districts;

units.zh: 會昌初，陳行泰殺節度使史元忠，權主留後。
units.en: Early in the Huichang era Chen Xingtai killed the military governor Shi Yuanzhong and seized control as acting administrator.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Huichang reign, Chen Xingtai killed the military governor Shi Yuanzhong and held the acting administrator's post on his own authority.

units.zh: 唐興，因隋樂不改，及黃巢之亂，樂縣散失，太常博士殷盈孫以周法鑄穀鐘、編鐘，處士蕭承訓等校石磐，合而奏之。
units.en: When the Tang rose, they retained Sui music unchanged. During Huang Chao's rebellion the court instruments were scattered and lost. The Court of Imperial Sacrifices academician Yin Yingsun recast grain bells and chime-bells by Zhou methods, while the reclusive scholar Xiao Chengxun and others retuned stone chimes, and the restored ensemble was played together once more.
units.literal: When the Tang rose, they took over Sui music without change; at the turmoil of Huang Chao the musical stands were scattered and lost; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices academician Yin Yingsun cast grain bells and chime-bells by Zhou methods, and the reclusive scholar Xiao Chengxun and others tuned stone chimes, and together they were played.

units.zh: 是時伶人景進用事，閹官競進，故重臣憂懼，拜章請退。
units.en: The actor Jing Jin then held sway and eunuchs crowded forward, so great ministers feared for themselves and begged to step down.
units.literal: At that time the actor Jing Jin held power, and eunuchs vied for advancement; hence the great ministers were fearful and submitted memorials asking to withdraw.

units.zh: 帝遣陝州康懷英、華州寇彥卿率兵攻迫邠、寧，以緩朔方之寇。
units.en: The Emperor sent Kang Huaiying of Shaan and Kou Yanqing of Hua to strike Bin and Ning and ease the Shuofang threat.
units.literal: The Emperor sent Shaan Prefecture’s Kang Huaiying and Hua Prefecture’s Kou Yanqing to attack Bin and Ning to relieve pressure on Shuofang.

units.zh: 陝州康懷英侵秦，克甯、慶、衍三州。
units.en: Kang Huaiying of Shaan attacked Qin and took Ning, Qing, and Yan.
units.literal: Kang Huaiying of Shaan invaded Qin and captured Ning, Qing, and Yan prefectures.

units.zh: 秦人來襲，懷英兵敗於升平。
units.en: Qin struck back and Huaiying was beaten at Shengping.
units.literal: Qin forces counterattacked and Huaiying was defeated at Shengping.

units.zh: 丙申，武德使史彥瓊自鄴馳報稱：「今月六日，貝州屯駐兵士突入都城，剽劫坊市。」
units.en: On bingshen Shi Yanqiong raced from Ye to report Beizhou garrison troops had stormed the city on the sixth and looted the markets."
units.literal: On bingshen Wude commissioner Shi Yanqiong galloped from Ye to report: "On the sixth of this month soldiers garrisoned at Beizhou burst into the capital and plundered the wards and markets."

units.zh: 明年六月，病篤，太祖令丁會代之，移罕之為河陽節度使；
units.en: The following year, in the sixth month, when Hanzhi became gravely ill, the Founder ordered Ding Hui to replace him and transferred Hanzhi to serve as military governor of Heyang;
units.literal: In the sixth month of the next year, gravely ill, the Founder had Ding Hui replace him and moved Hanzhi to Heyang military commissioner;

units.zh: 〈（案：《歐陽史》有《裴迪》、《韋震傳》，今原文已佚，無可采補。）〉
units.en: (The 《Ouyang History》 contains biographies of Pei Di and Wei Zhen; the original passage is lost and cannot be restored.)〉
units.literal: (Comment: the 《Ouyang History》 has biographies of Pei Di and Wei Zhen; the original text here is lost and nothing can be gathered to supplement it.)〉

units.zh: 六月，遣兗州節度使劉鄩、華州節度使尹皓、崇州節度使溫昭圖、莊宅使段凝領軍攻同州。
units.en: In the sixth month Liu Yan of Yan, Yin Hao of Hua, Wen Zhaotu of Chong, and Duan Ning of the Manor Estates marched on Tongzhou.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Yanzhou military commissioner Liu Yan, Huazhou military commissioner Yin Hao, Chongzhou military commissioner Wen Zhaotu, and Manor Estates commissioner Duan Ning led armies to attack Tongzhou.

units.zh: 八月，段凝、張朗攻衛州，下之，獲刺史李存儒以獻。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang took Weizhou and sent captive commissioner Li Cunru to court.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang attacked Weizhou and took it, capturing military commissioner Li Cunru and presenting him.

units.zh: 己巳，王彥章、段凝圍楊劉城。
units.en: On jisi Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu.
units.literal: On jisi, Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu city.

units.zh: 八月，以段凝代王彥章為北面行營招討使。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as northern commander.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as Northern Campaign Pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 戊子，段凝營於王村，引軍自高陵渡河，復臨河而還。
units.en: On wuzi Duan Ning camped at Wang village, crossed at Gaoling, and maneuvered along the river.
units.literal: On wuzi, Duan Ning encamped at Wang village, led troops from Gaoling to cross the river, and again faced the river returning.

units.zh: 帝聞中都之敗，唐軍長驅將至，遣張漢倫馳驛召段凝於河上；
units.en: Hearing of Zhongdu’s fall and Tang’s advance, the Emperor dispatched Zhang Hanlun to recall Duan Ning from the river;
units.literal: The Emperor heard of Zhongdu’s defeat and that Tang troops were coming at speed; he sent Zhang Hanlun by post relay to summon Duan Ning on the river;

units.zh: 時禁軍尚有四千人，朱圭請以拒唐軍，帝不從，登建國門召開封尹王瓚，謂之曰：「段凝未至，社稷係卿方略。」
units.en: Four thousand guards remained; Zhu Gui begged to fight; the Emperor refused, climbed the Founding Gate, called Wang Zan, and said: "Until Duan Ning comes the realm rests on you."
units.literal: At the time the Imperial Guard still had four thousand men; Zhu Gui asked to use them to resist Tang troops; the Emperor did not follow, ascended the Founding Gate, summoned Kaifeng Intendant Wang Zan, and said to him: "Duan Ning has not arrived—the altars depend on your strategy."
